purisasahassa.p: [ purisa + sahassa ] (na) Google Translate The prison of men Thousands of men. Purishata-see.

purisasata.p: [ purisa + sata ] (na) Google Translate Men's things Hundreds of men.

purisasaññī.p: [ purisa + saññī ] (ti) Google Translate He, who is called male.

purisasaṃsaṭṭha.p: [ purisa + saṃsaṭṭha ] (ti) Google Translate He who mingles with men.

R:
purisasaṃsaṭṭhā：ပုရိသ-သံသဋ္ဌာ （ဣ）
ယောကျ်ားနှင့် နှီးနှောသော။

purisasīha.p: [ purisa + sīha ] (ti) Google Translate A brave-great-man with a lion.

R:
purisasīha：ပုရိသ-သီဟ （ပ）
ခြငေ်္သ့ကဲ့သို့ ရဲရင့်သော ယောကျ်ား။

purisassara：ပုရိသ-ဿရ （ပ）
ယောကျ်ားအသံ။
